prompt: Automatically hide out-of-stock variants from storefront and maintain an admin log of all visibility changes.

intent.desiredOutcome: Automatically hide out-of-stock variants from storefront and maintain an admin log of all visibility changes.

platformGaps.gap: Shopify does not have a native per-variant visibility toggle — variants cannot be individually hidden from storefront without modifying the product
platformGaps.mitigation: Use the Shopify Admin GraphQL API productVariantUpdate mutation to set the variant's inventoryPolicy or, more reliably, use the REST Products API to set the variant's option value metadata; the practical approach is to update the variant's available_for_sale state by setting inventory_policy to 'deny' and inventory_quantity tracking so Shopify automatically marks it unavailable, combined with storing the change in the visibility_log table

platformGaps.gap: inventory_levels/update payload contains inventory_item_id and location_id but not variant_id or product_id directly
platformGaps.mitigation: After receiving the webhook, look up the variant_id from the inventory_item_id using the Shopify Admin REST GET /inventory_items/:id endpoint, then resolve the product_id from the variant record

platformGaps.gap: No batch write API for productVariantUpdate — each variant requires an individual Shopify API call
platformGaps.mitigation: Pre-fetch all required read data before the loop; per-item write calls inside the loop are unavoidable for this resource type

webhookContract.handlerMustProduce: Using inventory_item_id from the payload, resolve the corresponding variant_id and product_id by calling the Shopify Admin REST inventory_items endpoint. Determine the derived stock_status: if available (numeric quantity from payload) is greater than 0 the status is 'in_stock', otherwise 'out_of_stock'. Look up the existing inventory_level_state row by (tenant_id, inventory_item_id, location_id) to obtain the previous stock_status. Compare previous_status to new stock_status to determine whether a transition has occurred (in_stock → out_of_stock triggers hide_variant action; out_of_stock → in_stock triggers show_variant action). When a transition is detected, call the Shopify Admin GraphQL productVariantUpdate mutation to set available_for_sale false (hide) or true (show) on the variant. Upsert the inventory_level_state row with the new stock_status, variant_id, and product_id. Insert a visibility_log record capturing previous_status, new_status, available_quantity (the raw available integer from payload), action_taken ('hide_variant' or 'show_variant'), and shopify_api_result (success or error message from the Shopify mutation response). When no prior state row exists (first-ever event for this inventory_item+location), insert the state row and log the initial observation without triggering a hide/show action.
